I will describe my experience playing STARFIELD in the following words:
- Boring.
- Monotonously.
- Not interested.
- Empty.

author: manmyxa
quote: First time playing this game in 2021. Good game. Multiplayer and single sweetie. The graphics have surprisingly not lost their relevance. Especially against the background of the release of Battlefield 2042.

author: manmyxa
quote: I've played for 70 hours already and I'm not going to stop. I made love to battlefield i opened with battlefield 3. Thousands of people are trying to convince millions not to play. Think about it. Bad comments are left by one, and those who liked the game do not even know that something is wrong with it.

author: manmyxa
quote:
This is the best game I've played in recent years. A breath of fresh air in the gaming industry.
I advise everyone to buy the game and support the developers. CD Projekt RED guys - you managed to surprise the world again.
